payload.title: Rate-limit incoming webhooks per tenant
payload.goal: POST /webhooks answers 429 with a Retry-After header when one tenant sends more webhooks than the configured limit in the configured window. Put the limiter in src/lib/limiter.ts, wire it into src/routes/webhooks.ts (and src/app.ts if it needs shared state), and read the limit and the window through loadConfig() in src/config.ts with defaults. Add tests in test/webhooks.test.ts or a new test file.
acceptance: A tenant over the limit gets 429 with a Retry-After header
The limit and the window come from config, not constants in a route
The suite stays green with new tests for the 429 path

payload.text:
Done. Per-tenant rate limiting is implemented and the suite passes (33 tests, 7 files, ~0.7s) with typecheck clean.

decision: fixed-window per-tenant limiter in src/lib/limiter.ts shared via Deps
decision: rate limit checked right after tenant validation, before body parsing, so rejected requests are never stored or audited
decision: config keys RATE_LIMIT_MAX (default 100) and RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS (default 60000) read through loadConfig()
decision: tests: test/config.test.ts changed because the exact toEqual config expectations must include the two new rate-limit fields

Changes:
- New [limiter.ts](<fixture>/.stint/worktrees/T-0001-r2/src/lib/limiter.ts): `RateLimiter` class with fixed-window `check(key, limit, windowMs)` returning allowed/retryAfterSec.
- [config.ts](<fixture>/.stint/worktrees/T-0001-r2/src/config.ts): added `rateLimitMax` / `rateLimitWindowMs` via `loadConfig()`, no constants in routes.
- [app.ts](<fixture>/.stint/worktrees/T-0001-r2/src/app.ts): `limiter` added to `Deps` so all requests share state.
- [webhooks.ts](<fixture>/.stint/worktrees/T-0001-r2/src/routes/webhooks.ts): over-limit tenants get 429 `{ error: 'rate limit exceeded' }` with a `Retry-After` header.
- New [rate-limit.test.ts](<fixture>/.stint/worktrees/T-0001-r2/test/rate-limit.test.ts): 429 + header, other tenants unaffected, rejected webhooks not stored/audited, window expiry, plus limiter unit tests. `test/webhooks.test.ts` was left untouched.

Did not look at: `src/routes/events.ts`, `admin.ts`, `audit.ts`, `src/lib/backoff.ts`, `tenants.ts`, `src/server.ts`.
